newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says review to comply with charter.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says review to comply with charter.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday the government's mid-year budget review this month would comply with the new charter of budget honesty.

Costello told a meeting of the Young Liberals this meant the mid-year review would report fiscal risks and contingent liabilities for the first time. "Over time they (the new reporting requirements) will contribute to better and more focused decision making," Costello said.

Costello did not give a firm date for the release of the mid-year review but said it would be much more than the "five page press release" which he said the previous Labor government released in December 1995.

Under the charter of budget honesty, which has yet to become law, the government is required to make projections in the mid-year review for the budget year and three following years, as well as the economic assumptions underpinning them.
